summary: LAUNCH is the founder-support organisation of Jason Calacanis, backing early-stage startups through programmes, funds, The Syndicate and a media network. Its homepage lists funding paths: a 12-week pre-accelerator investing $25,000 or $125,000 in top participants, a 14-week accelerator at $125,000, and a growth path at $250,000 and above, alongside portfolio names such as Calm, Vanta and Superhuman. Founders apply through an online form. Geography and a street address are not stated.
